parsed.note_claim: His office stated as of July 2, 2026, that Mitch McConnell continues to improve in the hospital and is working with his staff.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: "The Senator continues to improve, and is working closely with his staff on Kentucky and Senate matters while the Senate is out of session," the statement continued.
parsed.reason: The page directly quotes the July 2 statement from McConnell's office confirming he is improving in the hospital and working with staff.
